column8: Tue 17 Nov: 3e evidence clause or reference; the fixed fuel words came 22 years after Avianca (Keel arithmetic on two dates), while the IPS's two reasons were written before the first dollar is invested; adds the delay to Q59-006 and Q59-007; say submitted 7 Nov 2026 (Sydney); one plain clause, no fuel image (tonight's voice round).
Tue 17 Nov: twin of Q59-006 (MINIMUM FUEL is not an emergency; Table 3's watches change nothing); adds only IFALPA's no-priority line; never call a watch MINIMUM FUEL in the report.

Tue 17 Nov: store or 3a clause; $34,369 and 11.4% are superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the extra Treasuries now cost $35,213 in 1 Jan 2027 money, 11.6% of $302,287 (Keel arithmetic; $36,774 in January 2028, NUMBERS 2); an airline's 5% is an input and the plan's share an output, so compare only as that; never call the extra Treasuries contingency (Q59-039).

Tue 17 Nov: twin of row 5 (aviation takes a smaller margin only with an exit; the ten have none, IPS l.11's anybody else's money); drop 'that is why the plan cannot take the smaller margin': the plan's margin is sized to a named case, never chosen as a percentage.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a or 3c reference; aviation lowers its coverage only with more ways out, and the ten have none (IPS l.11), so they are sized to a bound that holds in all 585 windows (NUMBERS 2) while only the range carries a confidence; adds EASA's three tiers to Q59-009; one plain clause at most, never a fuel image.

Tue 17 Nov: store only, input to row 9; contingency's job (forecast error on the trip) matches the extra Treasuries' subject, but they are expected back and never drawn at forwards (NUMBERS 8h), so never call them contingency (Q59-039).

Tue 17 Nov: 3a reference; since the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size the named case also has every iBond fund flow 0.5% smaller (NUMBERS 2), so add it; and the case covers every waiting dollar from 2027, not only each payment's worst wait (Q59-042's note); the Feb-2037 bond's 10.5 months is TNA l.5's; one plain clause, no fuel image.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a evidence clause; additional fuel is only the top-up beyond what the other fuel covers in the named failure, as the extra Treasuries are only what the ten's own Treasuries do not pay in the named case (NUMBERS 2, an exact linear programme); since tonight's re-size that case includes the 0.5% fund-cost margin; the escrow verifier's arithmetic (Q31) is the same-field precedent; in prose the extra Treasuries, never backstop (WORDS).

Tue 17 Nov: guard for 3.0 and 3a; no single fuel part fits the extra Treasuries, which corrects AHA_REGISTER's 'Every margin has a job and a spender' and Q59-003's map (alternate fuel holds for their end only); they keep their own name, the extra Treasuries (WORDS l.22).

Tue 17 Nov: the fact is Q87-030's (and Q20-016's): Mon 9 Nov's margin left the ten $22,192 short if cash waiting earns nothing and short in 35 of 585 windows (NUMBERS 2); its 7% was sized to rates 3 points lower, not set as a percentage, so the airline comparison breaks under its own disanalogy; say if cash waiting earns nothing (WORDS).

Tue 17 Nov: 3b store; the IPS named her flexibility's three uses in advance (l.15) and Laura alone decides, ranked by no one (WORDS); adds the proposer and decider split to Q59-011; at most one plain clause, no fuel words.

Tue 17 Nov: 3b clause or reference; discretion that cannot be encouraged or discouraged matches her flexibility, promised to no one (IPS l.15), never asked or offered to co-sponsors (SKELETON 3d) and never counted in the range; say never offered, not never heard; it never pays the payments (CANON A26).

Tue 17 Nov: store; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the test now counts fund costs beyond the fee at 0.5% (nothing spare under the full standard, $1,177 spare without the fund cost, NUMBERS 2), so drop 'a real uncounted item'; what stays uncounted is a cost above 0.5%.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a evidence for the margin; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the payments now carry the 0.5% margin and are $0 short at 0.5% (was $236 per 0.1%, $1,181; NUMBERS 2), so drop 'until then' and the Wed 18 Nov wording; 0.27% is Keel arithmetic on frictions, the ended funds show about 0.15% (bond desk 4, M3).

Tue 17 Nov: 3e and Table 3 evidence; a watch fires on a forecast before the reason does, as Table 3's deposit row already has (confirmed by 1 Dec 2027, nothing by 31 March 2028: four months' warning); one plain clause, no fuel words.

Tue 17 Nov: store; a watch marks an option lost (a fund ending early or merging, Table 3 row 4), never a reason to change; adds a second meaning to Q59-006; the Taiwan dollar example is looser (it narrows her flexibility, no option is lost).

Tue 17 Nov: 3c reference at most; counting only fuel aboard at take-off is evidence for stating a figure only once owned; corrects Q59-001's label (121.639 covers all domestic operations); one plain clause, never set beside ink as a picture (tonight's voice round).

Tue 17 Nov: store; restates Table 3's deposit row ($3,016 at today's rates with $57,455 if cash waiting earns nothing, both NUMBERS 5; never the $3,016 alone, and NUMBERS puts it on the 2033 payment); the fuel label adds nothing the report can use.

Tue 17 Nov: 3e; the two reasons watch flows from outside (a deposit, a Treasury's payment), never a level in the store, which is why a market fall is not one (IPS l.17); fix 'its holdings pay fixed amounts': the Treasuries do, the iBond funds pay their net asset value (TNA l.13, l.15); builds on Q7b-006.
Tue 17 Nov: twin of Q59-007 (Avianca's findings); adds the dispatch-system and FAA traffic causes, which answer claim 3 but serve no report part beyond Q59-007's one clause.
Tue 17 Nov: twin of Q59-007 (running out of fuel said, emergency never declared; fixed words read one way); its writing rule, Table 3's exact words every time, is already WORDS practice.
Tue 17 Nov: store only, context for rows 1 and 20; the casualty figures carry the page's own conflict; no report use.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a or Figure 1 note reference at most; a right reading in the wrong unit is the reason each figure is printed with its date and unit (WORDS); row 31's six figures moved tonight, see its note.

Tue 17 Nov: 3e or Table 3 evidence; the Board blamed a fuel sum nobody owned, and Table 3's Who column names one owner per check (Laura for the deposit, the team for Treasury payments); one plain clause at most.
Tue 17 Nov: same Board and the same lesson as row 24 (a rule nobody applies; one owner per check); anecdote only.

Tue 17 Nov: 3e or figure note; only the recommendation's heading was read; 8k's $1.48 predates tonight's 365.25-day fix, which caused $1.44 of it, and results_returns_2026-11-17.json now agrees to under a cent (route 2) and $0.31 (route 1): quote 8k only once it is updated; say the figures were checked two ways.
Tue 17 Nov: store only, context for row 29; a leak from maintenance as a Treasury default is a picture, not evidence, and a default is a payer's failure, not a crack.

Tue 17 Nov: store; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the 0.5% margin for fund costs beyond the fee is already on the payments (NUMBERS 2), not a Wed 18 Nov job; 0.27% is Keel arithmetic on frictions for a January 2028 buy (NUMBERS 0), while the ended funds show about 0.15% (bond desk 4, M3).

Tue 17 Nov: 3e evidence at most; never moving sound money into an unexplained loss matches Table 3's Never column after a default (no forced sale) and CANON A26 (VT never pays the payments); one plain clause, no fuel image.

Tue 17 Nov: Figure 1 note; the per-payment covers at zero interest ($2,587 to $4,451 for 2033-2036, NUMBERS 2 and 8h, unchanged by the re-size) are printed per bar so pooling never hides a gap; evidence only.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a presentation guard; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: now $35,213 (1 Jan 2027 money), $36,774 (January 2028 price), $37,711 (face and fund dollars), $55,920 (unchanged), $46,566 (1 Jan 2033 money) and $75,934 (by 1 Jan 2042), NUMBERS 2 and 8h; 3a still prints one figure per unit, with its date, once WORDS M11 is updated.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the floor now pays $102,365 against $115,930 under Mon 9 Nov's call and $136,328 with no margin, and what comes back is $75,934 by 1 Jan 2042, $46,566 in 1 Jan 2033 money (NUMBERS 2, 8h); the central range and the $15,000 gap at each end are unchanged; the fuel side is weak.

Tue 17 Nov: guard for every part; no fuel words for any part of Laura's money, at most one plain sentence of evidence; tonight's voice round, where every second image set up in a sentence failed with blind readers, confirms it.

Tue 17 Nov: store or 3a reference; since the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size the one case also has every iBond fund flow 0.5% smaller (NUMBERS 2), so add it; the other tests follow from the 0% test (NUMBERS 2), which this row says well; current eCFR text not read.

Tue 17 Nov: 3a evidence clause; superseded by the Tue 17 Nov evening re-size: the 0.5% margin already sits on top of the zero-interest case (NUMBERS 2), so drop the Wed 18 Nov and never-say-they-do wording; the parallel is an allowance on the worst case plus a watch (Table 3 row 4); 0.27% is Keel arithmetic, the ended funds show about 0.15% (bond desk 4, M3).
Tue 17 Nov: twin of Q59-006 (a watch asks nothing, a reason acts); the FAA's wording is the sharpest quote if 3e uses one clause, but Table 3's Changes and Never columns already say it.

Tue 17 Nov: store; one phrase with two definitions is why Table 3 states each reason with its test (31 March 2028; five business days); adds the two definitions to Q59-008's misuse; no report use beyond that.
Tue 17 Nov: store; the order (payments first, then the floor, then shares) is already IPS l.11 and l.15's own, so 3.0 states it from the IPS; EASA's ranked aims add nothing a judge needs.
Tue 17 Nov: same use as row 5 (the payments on a written bound, evidence only for the range) on a weaker source (the manual's description only); Q59-010 holds the variation's approval.
